# WiZ (`wiz`)

WiZ smart bulbs on the local network: power, brightness and colour over UDP, with no account and no key.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/wiz`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/wiz/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/wiz/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `light` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | no |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- UDP to the device, port 38899
- UDP broadcasts on the local network, port 38899

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bulbs` | Bulbs by address | a list of rows | no |  | Bulbs you name by address. Bulbs found by discovery do not need to be listed. |
| `bulbs[].id` | Id | text, at most 64 | yes |  | A short id for the bulb, such as bulb1. It is also the name the hub asks for. |
| `bulbs[].address` | Address | IP address or host name | yes |  | The bulb's IP address. Add :port only if it does not listen on the usual port. |
| `port` | Port | port | no | `38899` | The UDP port of a bulb whose address names none. |
| `broadcast` | Broadcast address | host:port | no |  | Where discovery sends its question, as IPv4 address:port: the top address of the bulbs' network, or 255.255.255.255:38899. Discovery is off until this is set. |

## Secrets

None.

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.
